raw_final_content:
The first two photographs show small sparrows with a compact conical bill, brown streaked upperparts and, most importantly, a chestnut-brown crown plus pale cheek with a dark cheek patch/area and dark throat. That combination is highly characteristic of Eurasian Tree Sparrow, Passer montanus (スズメ). The second frame clearly contains two individuals.

The third photograph is useful only as environmental context; the birds are not resolved well enough there to add plumage evidence. I would identify P. montanus at species level with high confidence. I would not, however, claim a definite age or sex for the second/right individual from these blurred views.
